effect_description_eng:
[On Play] [When Digivolving] [On Deletion] Until your opponent's turn ends, 1 of your Digimon with [Mamemon] in its name gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) and their effects can't return it to hands or decks.
(Rule) Name: Treated as including [Mamemon].
